What we do

Design. Install. Maintain. One team from the first idea to every season after.

Gardenlust takes your garden from concept to completion, then keeps it thriving. One team, accountable from the first sketch to the last prune.

Step one

Landscape design

Everything begins with an idea

We take you through the design process step by step and turn your idea into a garden shaped around your home and the way you live.

  • A guided, step-by-step design process
  • Designed around your lifestyle, not a template
  • The start of a long-term relationship
Start with a design
Step two

Installation

From inception to completion

Our qualified horticulturists and landscapers install the planting and soft landscaping. Where construction is needed, we bring in specialists chosen for your project.

  • Qualified horticulturists and landscapers
  • Construction experts matched to your project
  • Gardenlust manages it from start to finish
Plan an installation
Step three

Garden maintenance

We care, we love, we give

A horticulture service personalised to your garden, with visits completed on time and to the highest standard, and clear communication every step of the way.

  • Personalised to every garden
  • Visits managed and completed on time
  • Communication-first, always

From Paris, with love

From Paris rooftops to Sydney gardens.

Axel’s career began installing rooftop gardens on Haussmannian buildings in Paris. He spent more than 15 years with leading landscape design firms in France and Australia before founding Gardenlust in 2019.

His vision: gardens with “je ne sais quoi”, that undefinable essence that sets them apart from ordinary spaces. Every member of the team is handpicked and trained to deliver personalised service and impeccable attention to detail.
